content: Isra7eele Asay Siina Zumaa Achchafe Dendi Baana Mala Muses Godaa Azazo

Hessafe guye GODAY Muses, «Neninne ne Gibxeppe kessida asay hayssafe dendidi, ‹Tani intte zereththatas immana› ga woththida biittaa biite. He biittay tani Abrahaames, Yisaaqassinne Yaaqoobes immana gaada kase caaqqa woththidayssa.
Tani inttefe sinththara kiitanchcha kiittada, Kanaaneta, Amooreta, Hiiteta, Paarizeta, Hiiwetanne Yaabuseta gooddana.
Maaththinne eessi goggiza he biittaa biite. Gido attiin intte wozina muume as gidida gishshas tani inttena ogen dhayssontta mala ta inttenara biikke» gides.
Asay hessa iita yo7oza siyidi keehi yeekkides. He wodeppe doommidi asay wurikka alleqos aaththizayssa aggides.

Gaasoykka GODAY Muses, «Isra7eele asaas, ‹Intte wozina muumida asa. Haray attoshin guuththa wode ta inttenara issife bizaakko tani inttena dhayssana. Ha7i intte alleqo kessichite; histtiko tani intte bolla ay ooththanaakko intte beyana› ga» gi yooti woththides.
Isra7eele asay Siina zumaappe doommidi ba alleqo miishshaa kessi woththides.
Gaytoteththa Dunkaane
Musey Dunkaaneza ekki efidi asay dunkaanidasoppe haassi tolides. Dunkaanezi, «Gaytoteththa Dunkaane» geetetti summides. GODAA oychchanaas koyzay wuri he gayteththa dunkaaney dizaso bees.
Musey he dunkaanezakko bida wode aydekka asay wuri ba dunkaaneza pengen pengen eqqidi Musey dunkaanezan gelana gakkanaas iza xeellees.
Musey gayteththa dunkaaneza giddo gelida wode tuussa mala shaaray duge wodhdhiin GODAY Musera haasayshe dunkaaneza pengen gam7ees.
Tuussa mala shaaraza dunkaaneza pengen be7ida ubba wode, asay wuri ba pengen pengen eqqidi dizasohon dishe GODAAS goynnees.

Asi ba laggera haasayza mala GODAY Musera sinththan eqqidi haasayees. Hessafe guye Musey dunkaaney dizaso guye simmees shin iza maaddiza naateththa naa, Nawe naa Iyaasoy gaytoteththa Dunkaanezappe shaakettenna.
Musey Godaara Haasaydes
Musey GODAAS, «Neni tana, ‹Hayssa asaa kaaleththa› gadasashin tanara neni oona kiittizaakko tana erisabeekka. Neni, ‹Tani nena ne sunththan erays; neni ta sinththan sabettida asa› gadasa.
Ne sinththan ta sabettidaa gidikko tani nena erana malanne sinththafekka ne sinththan sabettashe daana mala, ne oge tana tamaarsa. Ha asay ne asa gididayssa qoppa» gides.
Histtiin GODAY zaaridi, «Tani nenara baana; tani nena shempisana» gides.
Histtiin Musey iza, «Neni nunara bonttaa gidikko hayssafe nuna kessofa.
Neni nunara bontta ixxiko tananinne ne asaan neni sabettidayssa asay wuri wostti eranee? Biitta bolla diza hara asa ubbaafe tananne ne asaa dummasizay hara miishshi aazee?» gides.
Histtiin GODAY Muse, «Ta nenan sabettida gishshassinne nena ne sunththan eriza gishshas neni tana oychchidayssa qasseka tani ooththana» gides.
Histtiin Musey, «Histtiko ne gita bonchchoza tana bessarkkii?» gides.
GODAY, «Tani ta lo7eteththaa ubbaa ne sinththara aaththana; ta geeshsha sunththaaka ne achchan awajjana. Tani GODAA; tani maaranaas koyzayta maarana; qasse mishettanaas koyzaytaska mishettana.
Gido attiin neni ta ayfeso beyakka; ays giikko oonikka tana be7idi paxa attenna» gides.
Hessafe guye GODAY, «Neni ta achchan eqqanaas zaalla bolla eqqanasoy hayssan dees.
Ta bonchchoy aadhdhi biza wode tani nena zaalla za7a giddon woththana. Aadhdhana gakkanaas ta kushen nena kammana.
Hessafe guye tani ta kushe diggiko neni ta zokko beyanashin ta ayfesoy beettanaas bessenna» gides.
